test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which State Assembly passed a resolution to create a Legislative Council in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **West Bengal** is the correct answer as the state assembly passed a resolution in **July 2021** to create a **Legislative Council,** which would act as a **second chamber **of the state legislature.
 
• The creation of a **Legislative Council in West Bengal **has been a topic of debate for several years and the resolution was passed after the ruling party won a majority in the state assembly elections held earlier in **2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **292 of the 294 constituencies** were included in the 2021 West Bengal Legislative Assembly election, which was the **17th quinquennial **legislative election for the 17th legislative assembly</st
